locator: DISCUSSION p. 298, right column, text row 4 ('then that average is found to be 29 µmoles per 100 gm of tissue per minute')
evidence: The sentence defines the value: brain taken as equal fractions of gray and white matter, the arithmetic means of the rates in the gray structures and in the white structures averaged. From the paper's own table (31 gray rows mean 46.581, 8 white rows mean 13.500) the average is 30.04. Printed 29 differs by 1.04 against a rounding allowance of 1.0 (each integer cell ±0.5, plus half a unit of the printed 29). Every table cell was re-read from 500-dpi renders. Excluding the spinal rows makes the discrepancy larger (30.9).
note: Marginal (0.04 beyond the rounding allowance); could come from unrounded per-structure means. Value kept as printed. Relevant to the audit: the compilations' monkey whole-brain values do not use 29 either (Karbowski prints 0.36 µmol/g/min, not derivable from this paper).
